study.question: Does the contiguous continuation of a newest target-matching field/action timestamp group supply useful information beyond the full latest-endpoint and ordered-switch incumbent, rather than merely exposing matching mass or extra readout capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: newest endpoint wins the prior matched replacement, while signed and folded oldest-to-newest drift lose; endpoints and aggregate switches do not uniquely encode terminal run length. Per receiving field/action, reuse the exact newest-first compact valid timestamp groups with match fractions p[0:G]. On G>1 define C_new=sum(k=2..G) product(i=0..k-1)p[i], i.e. expected number of additional initial matching groups under independent one-event-per-group draws. Append log1p(C_new)/log(129) scaled0.5. For binary groups C_new is newest matching run length minus1 (zero when newest is nonmatching). Fractional ties are descriptive soft products, not inferred within-timestamp order, a real event sequence, or causal persistence. Hypothesis: this explicit higher-order contiguous statistic helps beyond latest state, global adjacent switch rate and marginal counts.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit field-adapted local attention; the supplied normalized attention is not an exact DIN reproduction (primary lines272-277 explicitly abandon softmax). Proposed continuation is a deterministic target-field/action timestamp-run statistic alongside full parent, not a new attention or recurrent architecture. DIN reports sequence difficulties; it does not establish the present mechanism.

Author README verifies category/brand/type availability and absence of history item identity. Full publisher paper remains unavailable. This is no DMR reproduction or priority claim; no item identity is invented.

All parent inputs and parameter initialization preserved;8 further zero columns expose higher-order contiguous group products instead of replacing the winning newest state. Earlier endpoint, switch and count statistics cannot always identify terminal run length. Broad novelty remains unverified; authorized registry search found no additional nearest run-specific paper.

inherited_components: All r0027-latest_endpoint static embeddings, field-adapted attention, action/recency embeddings and MLP
Every ancestor count,decay,support,field retrieval,match/nonmatch extrema,rank,anchor,frontier,newer-count,ordered-switch and newest endpoint input
Exact existing validity rules, sorted raw ages, timestamp groups and tie fractions
study.proposed_difference: Append8 .5-scaled log-normalized continuation values, one per category/brand x four actions. Match capacity with identical8 zero-column extensions for oldest-oriented continuation, newest-anchored noncontiguous mass C_mass=p0*sum(p[1:G]), and duplicate newest endpoint (same .5 scale). All compute every table. Existing group support G>1, known action and positive target/field IDs are retained; no history extension or learned modules. The count scale log1p/log129 is fixed from the128-event history cap. Products are finite[0,1]; full group support is common across modes even if feature zeros differ.
predictions: Primary: newest_run validation AUC exceeds all3 matched controls, not merely the historical narrower parent. At least+0.0001 over both duplicate_endpoint and noncontiguous_mass is a predeclared practical screening threshold, not a significance threshold. Any smaller gain remains inconclusive.
Newest vs oldest contrast favors newest if recent continuation is consequential. Noncontiguous mass performance matching or exceeding newest run instead supports composition/scale over contiguity.

Source checks should preserve full parent features and parameter RNG, with zero new feature weights. Newest run differs from matching mass on sequences with intervening nonmatches even with equal group count,match count,endpoints and switch rate.

All8 extras zero on absent targets/fields,G<=1,empty/masked histories; bounds finite and permutations within/between equal timestamps leave deterministic tables invariant. Candidate first512 diagnostics are implementation checks only.

Record AUC,unweighted logloss,parameters,wall/train time,memory,throughput,batch latency and existing slices; AUC improvement with worse logloss is a tradeoff. No cost efficiency claim without measured frontier.
falsifiers: Failure to exceed duplicate_endpoint weakens incremental usefulness under this frozen recipe. A null/negative implementation is not a general refutation of temporal persistence.
Noncontiguous mass >= newest run weakens the contiguous-order explanation; oldest >= newest weakens recency localization. If only a single comparison is favorable, do not claim mechanism support.
Any changed parent prefix, nonfinite values,unsupported signal,dependence on arbitrary event order inside ties,unavailable feature,or budget overrun invalidates the implementation.
If apparent advantage does not repeat against closest controls across paired seeds42,43,44, retain preliminary/null conclusion; repeated seeds quantify stability, not independent mechanism contrasts.
alternative_explanations: Same-source single-seed validation selection over113 trajectories can overfit validation; no test data available to resolve generalization.
A direct deterministic readout may aid optimization even when information was implicit; duplicate control handles width but cannot equate feature value distributions.
Noncontiguous mass has a different numerical distribution despite matched theoretical range,log transform and scale; a run advantage is provisional, not isolated causal proof.
Fractional tied groups use independent draw interpretation; this is a statistic of observed category/brand/action history, not latent intent, repeated-item identity or true session duration.
128-event truncation censors runs and varies temporal coverage; missing fields and sparse actions limit scope. No ages/time gaps enter this added statistic.
Inherited full architecture has many selected branches. This study tests one added readout, not necessity of all inherited mechanisms.
